metadata.title: Recovery and transport of industrialwaste heat for their use in urban district heating and cooling networks using absorption systems

eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: Equivalent electricity saving (EqES). Defined as the ratio between the heating and cooling produced
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2 LIMIAR LITERAL v2.3 (revertido apos verificacao adversarial): o limiar registado e um teste de IDENTIFICABILIDADE, nao de qualidade — 'presents, proposes, evaluates OR critiques ... with sufficient detail to identify and characterise'. A §3.3 'Performance Indicators' define COPH_tot, COPC_tot, eficiencia exergetica e Equivalent Electricity Saving EqES = (QH/COPref + QC/EERref)/QWH - 1 com variaveis e forma funcional explicitas, e o EqES normaliza contra eficiencias de tecnologia de referencia fixadas externamente (COPref 3,7/3,1/2,5; EERref 4,1) — um construto de baseline de referencia. Nenhuma das tres clausulas de inelegibilidade morde.
